svg.title: Owen A. Hurtado | Scientific Computing
svg.desc: Physics undergraduate exploring computation, numerical methods and astrophysics. The Flamm paraboloid represents an equatorial spatial slice outside a Schwarzschild black hole's event horizon. The surface is stationary, with synchronized decorative lighting. Occasional straight particle trails are an artistic interpretation inspired by neutrinos; their timing is deterministic.

g.aria-label: Schwarzschild radius r sub s equals two G M over c squared. Embedding height z squared equals four r sub s times r minus r sub s.
